our_takes.our-take: The Airwallex Corporate Debit Card is a business-focused spending card built for companies with cross-border expenses and tight spend control needs. Its standout advantages are 0% foreign transaction fees, native multi-currency spending, and real-time card controls, making it practical for paying overseas suppliers, SaaS subscriptions, and business travel without FX surcharges. Unlike credit cards, it draws directly from your Airwallex balance—ideal for teams prioritising cost visibility and budget discipline over credit.
our_takes.good-for:
Businesses paying overseas suppliers or FCY subscriptions
Finance teams issuing cards with custom spend limits
Companies that prefer debit-based spending to avoid interest
Remote teams using virtual cards for online tools
our_takes.things-to-note:
This is a 
debit card
—spend comes from available balances only
Cashback (if any) is plan-dependent, not guaranteed
Per active cardholder fees may apply under some plans
No ATM or cash withdrawals supported
Auto FX conversion applies if you don’t hold the currency
